summary: MINISO Group filed a Form 6-K on May 27, 2026, announcing its unaudited financial results for the quarter ended March 31, 2026. The press release reports revenue growth of 28.5% YoY to RMB 5,688.4 million, operating profit growth of 114.3% YoY, and net profit growth of 199.7% YoY. It also provides a store network update, with total stores reaching 8,565. The filing is a routine earnings release and does not disclose any special-situation corporate event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. It is an ordinary current report by a foreign private issuer.
